entities.name: Flubs
entities.description: Legendary frogfolk scout from Bloomburrow, rumored to be the luckiest creature alive, who explores beyond his plane via Omenpaths.

entities.name: Lumra
entities.description: Ever-shifting forests that Flubs alone among animalfolk escaped.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Passages between planes that Flubs stumbles through.

entities.name: Flubs's following
entities.description: Mysterious multiversal organization that grew from Flubs's small following, with Flubs at its center.

events.summary: Flubs escapes the ever-shifting forests of Lumra, the only animalfolk known to do so.
events.quote: He is the only animalfolk known to have escaped the ever-shifting forests of Lumra.

events.summary: After the Omenpaths open, Flubs explores beyond his plane and gathers a small following that grows into a multiversal organization.
events.quote: Through a series of mishaps stumbling from Omenpath to Omenpath, he even gathered a small following.
